svg.title: The graph behind it: from the findspot back to a place
svg.text: the tephra leads from one place to another — and the second is itself a findspot of the same dataset
862 km away · findspot 22 of the same dataset
the coordinate in the same row, however,
lands exactly on the correct node.
the same structure — only here every edge ends in a sentence instead of an identifier
geolod:Cave · geolod:elevation_m 550 · no skos:closeMatch, no owl:sameAs
“Type site for Homo floresiensis” sits in the
dataset as free text. Without a QID the
statement can neither be confirmed nor refuted
from outside — which is exactly what the
identifiers did for findspots 22 and 48 above.
placed by its coordinate, not by a statement

Two findspots from two sub-projects of the same repository: for one, every edge ends on an identifier and leads to a second place; for the other it ends in a sentence — and the nearest nameable place is an island.
